paraphrase: For any chosen description and primitive intervention family, closed macro transitions exist exactly when every primitive transition preserves equal coarse data; any realizing macro transitions reproduce all finite intervention histories. The inhabited two-simple identity-parthood fixture realizes a nonlinear AND response under joint writes and swaps, distinguishes coupled from uncoupled arrangements with the same intrinsic bits, and loses closure when a local bit flip is added.
